segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, the Harmonic Conjugate governs projective division along central lines. Four collinear points A, B, C, and D form a harmonic range when C and D divide segment A B internally and externally in the exact same ratio.

segments.text: Because the Centroid X two divides the segment from Circumcenter X three to Orthocenter X four in a one-to-two ratio, and the Nine-Point Center X five bisects X three X four, the four classical Euler centers X two, X four, X three, and X five form a canonical harmonic range with cross-ratio negative one.
